attributes.board_name: Iowa Board of Nursing (Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Since June 4, 2025 the board no longer approves CE providers or content; any CE of appropriate nursing/health-care subject matter counts (offerings of at least 1 hour; CPR/BLS not accepted)
rules.new_licensee_rule: First license runs 2 years plus the months to the birth month (24-36 months); then renewal every 3 years.
rules.alternatives: Current national certification or recertification, or a nurse residency program, counts as the full 36 hours; academic credit (1 semester hour = 15 hours), a board-approved refresher course, and 60+ hours as a preceptor (6 hours) also count.
rules.audit_note: Keep CE documentation 4 years for audit; late renewals may be audited.

topics.who: nurses caring for children and/or dependent adults (Iowa HHS course; certificate valid 3 years)

rules.notes: License expires the 15th of the birth month every 3 years; Iowa law asks for renewal 30 days before expiry, 30-day grace period with $50 late fee.
